items.briefing:
Check Point's research, echoed by Australian Cyber Security Magazine, highlights a growing concern for local organisations: AI data exposure is now the second most common AI-related security incident in Australia and New Zealand. This means staff may be accidentally leaking sensitive business information when using AI tools like chatbots. Cyber attacks broadly are also on the rise, so all organisations should remain alert.

**Practical tip:** Avoid entering confidential client details, passwords, or internal documents into AI chat tools — treat them like a public forum.
